answer: Attestation weight decays geometrically with repetition: the k-th vouch between the same pair counts 0.5^(k-1), so fake accounts that echo praise at each other cap at 2 units per pair. Each vouch also locks a 10 POA timber bond, slashed if an audit finds a closed loop. Faking 1,000 units thus needs about 500 distinct real counterparties and 10,000 POA at risk. Colluders cannot share costs because decay is per pair, so no ring is a haven; honest agents who trade widely barely notice.
